department: School of Mechanical, Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering (MIME)

deadline.value: Priority deadline is December 15 and the final is January 31, but the page gives no year.
deadline.quote: M.S. / Ph.D. Priority Application Deadline: December 15

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for the Mechanical Engineering programs.

notes: MIME's FAQ covers Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Robotics together. The priority deadline (December 15) is given with no year on both pages.
